race.comment: ROSSANADO (9) pushed forward and was too good fresh leading throughout. Fitter and has a top record at this course and distance. Tricky gate but expected to go close again. WALLENDA (2) was fifth last time but in open class. Was a fresh-up winner the start prior and looks well placed here. TIME TO BACA (11) has been runner-up at both starts this campaign, the latest here behind ROSSANADO. Ready to break through and gets a chance to turn the tables. AWASH (5) had been rock-solid with three placings in a row before finishing fifth over 1600m at this track last start. Should be poised just off the lead. One to consider. SHISUTA BO (4) was a winner two back then a solid fourth latest. Going well and among the chances.
